Subway-Style WhatsApp Ordering & Upsell Agent v1.0.0

- Launches a WhatsApp-based ordering agent for QSRs with natural language recognition.
- Implements proactive upsell suggestions based on current order content.
- Integrates ThumbGate protection to avoid double-charging, inventory errors, and allergen oversight.
- Syncs inventory status in real time from Google Sheets, preventing orders for out-of-stock items.
- Structured order workflow with greeting, order capture, upsell, validation, and confirmation steps.
- Logs all orders and flags potential errors in compliance with QSR standards.
